identification: Small cast iron figure of a rabbit lying on its back holding up a five-petal flower (poppy or wild rose) dish with its paws and feet, 9 cm high x 16 cm long. Dark brown rust-patina 'antique' finish with a granular sand-cast surface. This is a standard modern imported garden or trinket ornament (sold as a bunny bird feeder, candle holder, soap dish or 'float vase'), made in China in large numbers from about the 2000s, not an antique.
